english.note: Use this for the previous item, version, term of office, or other member in an ordered series, such as 上一任總理.
Use this for a specifically named previous period, such as 上個月 for ‘last month’ or 上個禮拜 for ‘last week’.

examples.english: The previous prime minister did quite well.
